verdict.rationale: Lago's docs confirm real-time usage-based metering, webhooks for event errors/retries, and dashboards for revenue/customer usage, which support visibility into current usage, but there is no explicit documentation of configurable usage thresholds or proactive alerting before invoicing to prevent surprises. Missing for 10: threshold/alert configuration, customer-facing real-time cost accrual UI, and evidence of alert delivery before invoice generation.
